answer.summary: Using the cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation from Field Trials of Health Interventions (Hayes & Moulton) Chapter 5, Section 6.1, including the additive one-cluster correction, a two-sided cluster-randomized trial comparing treatment rate 0.005 to control rate 0.010 per child-week, with 2500 child-weeks exposure per cluster, between-cluster coefficient of variation κ = 0.25, targeting 90% power at α = 0.05 significance level with equal allocation, requires 7 clusters per arm. At this design, achieved power is 90.91%; the preceding admissible design (6 clusters per arm) achieves 85.28% power, confirming that 7 is the minimum design meeting the target.
answer.method: Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation with additive one-cluster correction per Field Trials of Health Interventions, Hayes & Moulton, Chapter 5, Section 6.1. Expected event counts per cluster: m_c = 25 (control), m_t = 12.5 (treatment). Variance inflation due to between-cluster heterogeneity: Var_c = m_c(1 + κ²m_c) = 64.0625, Var_t = m_t(1 + κ²m_t) = 22.2656. Sample size formula for equal allocation: k = (z_α + z_β)² × (Var_c + Var_t) / (m_c − m_t)² = 10.5074 × 86.3281 / 156.25 = 5.8054 clusters. One-cluster correction: k_corrected = 5.8054 + 1 = 6.8054. Rounding upward to integer: k = 7 clusters per arm. Power verification: z = √(7−1) × 12.5 / √86.3281 = 3.295, power = Φ(3.295 − 1.96) = 0.9091. Preceding design (k=6) achieves power = 0.8528 < 0.90.

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation (Field Trials Chapter 5, Section 6.1)
# Hayes & Moulton methodology for cluster-randomized trials with unequal cluster rates

# Input parameters
p_control <- 0.010          # control rate per child-week
p_treatment <- 0.005        # treatment rate per child-week
exposure_cluster <- 2500    # child-weeks per cluster
kappa <- 0.25               # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05               # significance level (two-sided)
power_target <- 0.90        # target power
allocation_ratio <- 1       # equal allocation

# Critical value for two-sided test
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # two-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # power determines z_beta

# Expected event counts per cluster
mu_c <- p_control * exposure_cluster       # control: expected events per cluster
mu_t <- p_treatment * exposure_cluster     # treatment: expected events per cluster

cat("Expected event counts per cluster:\n")
cat("  Control (m_c):", mu_c, "\n")
cat("  Treatment (m_t):", mu_t, "\n")

# Cluster-rate CV approximation
# The variance inflation due to between-cluster heterogeneity is:
# Var_c = μ_c * (1 + κ²μ_c)  for control
# Var_t = μ_t * (1 + κ²μ_t)  for treatment

var_c <- mu_c * (1 + kappa^2 * mu_c)
var_t <- mu_t * (1 + kappa^2 * mu_t)

cat("\nVariance components (cluster-rate CV approximation):\n")
cat("  Var_c (control):", var_c, "\n")
cat("  Var_t (treatment):", var_t, "\n")

# Sample size formula for cluster-randomized trial, equal allocation
# k = number of clusters per arm
# (z_α + z_β)² * (Var_c + Var_t) / (μ_c - μ_t)²

rate_diff <- mu_c - mu_t
cat("\nRate difference (μ_c - μ_t):", rate_diff, "\n")

# Unadjusted sample size calculation
k_continuous <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (var_c + var_t) / (rate_diff^2)

cat("\nSample size calculation:\n")
cat("  (z_α + z_β)² =", (z_alpha + z_beta)^2, "\n")
cat("  Numerator (Var_c + Var_t) =", (var_c + var_t), "\n")
cat("  Denominator (rate_diff²) =", (rate_diff^2), "\n")
cat("  Continuous k (no correction) =", k_continuous, "\n")

# Hayes & Moulton additive one-cluster correction
# Add 1 to each arm after calculation
k_corrected <- k_continuous + 1

cat("\nOne-cluster correction applied:\n")
cat("  k after +1 correction =", k_corrected, "\n")

# Upward rounding to integer
k_rounded <- ceiling(k_corrected)

cat("\nFinal result (rounding upward):\n")
cat("  Clusters per arm (k) =", k_rounded, "\n")

# Verification: compute achieved power at k_rounded
k_rounded_continuous <- k_rounded - 1  # remove one-cluster correction to recover effective k
z_power_achieved <- sqrt(k_rounded_continuous) * abs(rate_diff) / sqrt(var_c + var_t)
power_achieved <- pnorm(z_power_achieved - z_alpha)

cat("\nPower verification at k =", k_rounded, ":\n")
cat("  Achieved z-statistic:", z_power_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power:", power_achieved, "\n")

# Also check power at preceding admissible design (k_rounded - 1)
k_prev <- k_rounded - 1
k_prev_continuous <- k_prev - 1
z_power_prev <- sqrt(k_prev_continuous) * abs(rate_diff) / sqrt(var_c + var_t)
power_prev <- pnorm(z_power_prev - z_alpha)

cat("\nPower at preceding admissible design (k =", k_prev, "):\n")
cat("  Achieved z-statistic:", z_power_prev, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power:", power_prev, "\n")

# Output in structured format
results <- list(
  clusters_per_arm = k_rounded,
  continuous_k = k_continuous,
  k_with_correction = k_corrected,
  power_achieved = power_achieved,
  power_preceding = power_prev,
  control_rate = p_control,
  treatment_rate = p_treatment,
  rate_difference = rate_diff,
  between_cluster_cv = kappa,
  exposure_per_cluster = exposure_cluster,
  var_control = var_c,
  var_treatment = var_t
)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Method: Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation (Field Trials Chapter 5.6.1)\n")
cat("Target power: 90%, Two-sided α = 0.05, Equal allocation\n")
cat("CLUSTERS PER ARM:", results$clusters_per_arm, "\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(results$power_achieved, 4), "\n")
cat("Power at k-1 =", k_prev, ":", round(results$power_preceding, 4), "\n")

cat("  Treatment (m_t):", mu_t, "\n")
